summary: Fruit Zombie Survival is a Roblox survival game by Vibed Games. Players eat Devil Fruits to unlock powers, survive endless zombie waves and special bosses, place special builds using One Piece characters, collect Berries to power up during runs, and cooperate with up to four friends while competing on global leaderboards.
coreMechanics: Eat Devil Fruits to unlock powers.
Survive endless zombie waves that include special bosses.
Choose One Piece characters to place special builds during a run.
Farm Berries to power up during a run.
Team up with up to four friends and compete on global leaderboards.

entities.notes: Devil Fruits can be eaten to unlock powers, and the game advertises 20 fruits to collect.
The main survival challenge consists of endless waves of zombies.
Special bosses appear during the zombie waves.
Players can choose One Piece characters to place special builds during a run.
Special builds can be placed during a run through selected One Piece characters.
Berries are farmed during runs and used to power up.
The official description says players can climb global leaderboards.
The official description supports teams of up to four friends.

Guide coverage describes working codes that can provide diamonds, a crate roll, a revive, and an Artifact Crate Roll with 2x Luck. Specific currently valid codes are not included in the fetched source text.
A codes guide states that codes can reward free diamonds.
A codes guide states that a newly released code rewards an Artifact Crate Roll with 2x Luck.
A codes guide states that codes can provide a spare revive.

facts.statement: Fruit Zombie Survival is developed by Vibed Games.
Players can eat a Devil Fruit to unlock its power.
The game advertises 20 fruits to collect.
Players must survive endless zombie waves.
Special bosses are included in the zombie waves.
Players can pick One Piece characters to place special builds during a run.
Players can farm Berries to power up during a run.
The game supports teaming up with up to four friends.
Players can compete on global leaderboards.
A published codes guide reports that codes can award diamonds, a crate roll, and a spare revive.
A published update reports a new code rewarding an Artifact Crate Roll with 2x Luck.
The supplied source metrics report 4,466 players at research time.
